Add both pod-level (runAsNonRoot: true) and container-level (allowPrivilegeEscalation, readOnlyRootFilesystem, capabilities.drop) securityContext fields — they live in different places in the spec
nginx needs to write to /var/cache/nginx and /var/run at startup — add emptyDir volumes mounted at both paths or nginx will crash with read-only filesystem
capabilities.drop must be a list: ["ALL"] — add capabilities.add: ["NET_BIND_SERVICE"] only if nginx needs to bind port 80 (it doesn't when running as UID 101 with port 8080)
